# Anomalies

## Buoy SST anomalies

We can easily calculate a climatology (by month) and subsequent anomalies for
each buoy, and plot results:
```{r, buoyanomalies, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 12, out.width = "100%"}
all_buoys_anomalies <- calculate_anomalies(buoy_sst)

plot(all_buoys_anomalies, text_size = 3)
```

## Monthly anomalies for a specific buoy

```{r, buoyanomalies2, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 12, out.width = "100%"}
plot(all_buoys_anomalies,
     stn_id = "Halibut Bank")   # In the Strait of Georgia
```

## Anomalies over several months for all buoys

```{r, buoyanomaliesmonths, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 12, out.width = "100%"}
plot(all_buoys_anomalies,
     months = 4:6,
     text_size = 3)
```

## Anomalies over winter months for all buoys

```{r, buoyanomaliesmonths2, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 12, out.width = "100%"}
plot(all_buoys_anomalies,
     months = c(12, 1, 2, 3),
     text_size = 3)
```
